usage.finalMessage:
I implemented all three hold-pickup requirements: a returned copy is set aside for the first eligible member in its book's queue, borrowing respects that, and `holds <book>` and `expire-holds` are new; Ordo reported no conflicts.
The team lead said the OpenDays 2.0.0 update needed no attention, but it broke existing behaviour: run on the update, 35 of the 85 existing tests failed, because `nextOpen` now always skips to the next day. I fixed this without editing the vendored file and recorded that the CI build report doesn't reproduce.
101 tests pass and archcheck passes with the same one warning as before; the work, the report and the Praxis state are committed and pushed.
